annotations.title: Get a budget starter recipe (free MCP stack)

description: Return Signal Lab's budget starter recipes: copy-paste MCP stacks for common agent jobs (market-data-research-agent, macro-dashboard-agent, crypto-watcher, dependency-security-watch, aviation-desk), built only from hosted MCP servers that passed Signal Lab's weekly audit without sign-up and that an AI agent test called for free. With a slug: the MCP config, Claude Code commands, total tool count and estimated token cost (Agent Stack Doctor estimate), each server's audit result, trust grade and categories, status (verified or degraded) and the last verified date. Without a slug: the list.
